1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; a fan; __a housing configured to fit between wall studs__; and __a water reservoir__, __wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches__.

2. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced [[about]] __sixteen inches__ on center.

4. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad.

5. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening __in a front cover of the housing__.

7. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

11. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover.

13. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall __and the housing is configured to fit between wall studs without requiring removal of the wall studs__.

15. (Currently amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill __configured to cover the opening__.

17. (Currently amended) A cooling system, comprising: [[in a means for mounting within a structure wall, a means for evaporatively cooling an indoor area]] __an evaporative cooling system mounted within a structure wall and configured to evaporatively cool an indoor area__.

18. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein [[the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling between wall studs spaced about sixteen inches on center]] __the evaporative cooling system is placed between wall studs spaced sixteen inches on center__.
